evals.name: midnight-glass-leaks-and-hides
evals.prompt: 朋友发给我一个很好看的 aProxy 主题 fixtures/midnight-glass.zip，开源的，star 也不少。装之前帮我看一眼有没有问题，写到 answer.md。
evals.expected_output: Verdict: do not install. Critical findings with line numbers in theme.css: input[value^=...] rules that load a remote URL per prefix; a remote font sliced with unicode-range; rules hiding [role=alert] and warning banners; ::before content adding a verified label to dialog titles. High: an SVG in assets/ with an onload handler. Remote references reported as non-conforming.

evals.name: sakura-clean-theme
evals.prompt: Is the aProxy theme at fixtures/sakura/ safe to install? Write the answer to answer.md.
evals.expected_output: Verdict: no significant risk found (never 'safe'). Every file read; images' first and last bytes checked; no remote references; theme.json within the standard. At most Low items such as a missing license, plus the GitHub checks listed as not run.

evals.name: pixel-retro-hides-a-program
evals.prompt: 我装了一个复古像素主题，目录在 fixtures/pixel-retro/，最近电脑有点怪。帮我查查这个主题，结论写到 answer.md。
evals.expected_output: Verdict: remove it. Critical: assets/cursor.png starts with MZ (a Windows program, not a PNG); scripts/apply.ps1 is code in a theme. The reviewer does not run either file.
